tours.description: This guide shows how to sell goods on credit to a customer who is late paying an earlier invoice and who is also asking for more credit than the company normally allows. Odoo will not let you confirm such an order on your own. You will see how to look at the overdue details, ask for the two approvals, let the authorised person approve, and then finish the sale: confirm, deliver, invoice and record the payment.
